title: Outbound intelligence system
description: Replaced a broken spreadsheet-and-gut-feel outbound motion with a structured AI agent stack: enrichment, scoring, and sequence drafting in a single operator loop.
problem: A B2B SaaS team was running outbound from a mix of manually-enriched spreadsheets, Apollo exports, and instinct. Coverage was inconsistent, personalization was template-based, and the cycle from list to sent sequence was two to three weeks.
system: Claude Code with four MCP integrations (LinkedIn, Apollo, HubSpot, Clearbit), a client-specific CLAUDE.md operator brief, and named skills for each stage: account scoring, ICP classification, signal extraction, and sequence drafting. Each run produces scored accounts with drafted sequences ready for human review, not a bulk send.
artifact: Operator stack: CLAUDE.md brief, four MCP connections, five named skills. A 50-account cold CSV goes to scored accounts with personalized sequence drafts in under an hour. Output reviewed and approved before any contact is made.
outcome: Outbound cycle compressed from 2–3 weeks to under a day. Sequences reference actual account-specific signals rather than generic personalization tokens. The system compounds: by month three the operator context is dense enough that a new account run starts significantly ahead of where a first run would.
